answer: Pool rewards by funding source. Every new agent's first deposit is traced back on-ledger, and all identities funded from the same wallet share a single reward cap that is split between them. A farmer who scatters one stake across a thousand keys, like sand blown across a dune, still collects one cap's worth, so splitting earns nothing. An honest agent grazing its own meadow of tasks keeps its full share, while the sybil's per-key payout sinks toward its nadir with every clone it adds.
